backup-recovery.note: PDF proof: centred byline, ragged-right paragraphs with a note, Crimson Pro default for new fiction designs, shared margin units; EPUB requests hyphenation; export report and Word exchange panels reordered. Salvage changes only pin a test design's font. The compatibility guide records the typography defaults.

native-packaging.migration: Desktop identifier changes leave books, settings, and SQLite schema 17 unchanged. Windows retains its previous WebView2 profile; Android now requires the separate package migration below. macOS starts fresh regenerable caches and native window restore state, leaving old entries untouched. Keep the normal closed-book and profile backup before upgrade; rollback uses the previous package and preserved files. Android migration: update the previous cc.local.app to transfer-capable 0.0.3, export a complete backup copy of each book archive and separate recovery key, install com.usegarret.app alongside it, import and compare manuscripts, notes and pictures before removing the old app. Preferences need resetting; both apps stay independent. Keep exports and old books for rollback; later edits require fresh exports into a compatible build. Retain the signing key and keep increasing version codes during release preparation. none: ceiling unchanged, writes refused.
